title: Citeck Journal Settings Schema
description: Saved view (report) over an existing journal: uiserv/journal-settings. Assembled from ecos-uiserv `domain/journalsettings/dto/JournalSettingsDto.kt` and the real artifacts of ecos-service-desk — the ecos-idea-plugin has no schema for this kind.

attribute.description: Attribute of the journal's type to sort by.

id.description: Attribute id of the journal's type, or a service attribute.

name.description: What this saved view is called in the journal's settings list.

journalId.description: LOCAL id of the journal this view belongs to (not a ref), e.g. `purchase-request-journal`.

authorities.description: Authorities the view is shared with, e.g. `GROUP_EVERYONE`. Empty means the author only.

workspaces.description: Workspace ids the view is visible in. Omit to keep the platform default.

settings.description: The view itself: which columns, in what order, sorted and grouped how, filtered by what.

groupBy.description: Attribute ids (or grouping expressions) the rows are aggregated by.

predicate.description: Filter of the view, in the platform predicate format.
